note: The surface-class manifest (S05 P5, design E2). Classifies every exports-map entry except the mechanical ./package.json. Ships in the tarball beside README.md; enforced by script/check-sdk-surface-labels.mjs. frozen entries carry no in-source marker by design: their classification lives here alone so the frozen sources stay untouched.

..reason: The S03 transaction/domain contract barrel — the transaction contract itself.

./conformance.reason: The transaction-contract conformance suite — S03's executable contract truth, additive-only with the contract it enforces.

./conformance/requirements.reason: P3's requirement-index legibility layer over the frozen suites — test infrastructure that may be reorganized as suites evolve, without touching the contracts it indexes.

./draft.reason: The draft-session domain surface — the S03 transaction contract's draft leg.

./draft/conformance.reason: The draft conformance suite — executable contract truth (S03/S04).

./engine.reason: The engine — S04-frozen; engine/engine.ts is one of the four byte-identical frozen surfaces the close-out control re-proves.

./engine/invariant.reason: Engine invariant entry (validateTransactionDocument) — engine contract surface consumed in production (P1's declared entry, not a rewrite).

./engine/conformance.reason: The engine conformance suite — executable contract truth (S04).

./vectors.reason: The vectors runner — S04-frozen contract surface, Host-neutral by design.

./vectors/corpus.reason: The vectors corpus — S04 contract test data published by P3 with exact-bytes guarantees; changing a corpus file changes contract coverage.

./vectors/drivers.reason: The corpus drivers — S04-era vectors machinery, frozen with the runner they drive.
